definitions.text_mt: It-tieni jum tal-ġimgħa wara l-Ħadd u qabel it-Tlieta, l-ewwel jum tal-ġimgħa tax-xogħol.

usage_examples.mt: Nhar it-Tnejn se nibdew ix-xogħol il-ġdid.
usage_examples.en: On Monday we will start the new work.
usage_examples.text_mt: Nhar it-Tnejn se nibdew ix-xogħol il-ġdid.
usage_examples.text_en: On Monday we will start the new work.

usage_notes.mt: Jintuża bl-artiklu assimilat 'it-Tnejn' bħala l-jum tal-ġimgħa; bħala numru kardinali, ara 'tnejn' (2).
usage_notes.en: Takes the assimilated definite article 'it-Tnejn' as the day of the week; for the cardinal numeral (2), see lowercase 'tnejn'.

definitions.text_mt: It-tielet jum tal-ġimgħa wara t-Tnejn u qabel l-Erbgħa, it-tieni jum tal-ġimgħa tax-xogħol.

usage_examples.mt: Nhar it-Tlieta se nivvjaġġaw lejn Għawdex.
usage_examples.en: On Tuesday we will travel to Gozo.
usage_examples.text_mt: Nhar it-Tlieta se nivvjaġġaw lejn Għawdex.
usage_examples.text_en: On Tuesday we will travel to Gozo.

usage_notes.mt: Jintuża bl-artiklu assimilat 'it-Tlieta'; għan-numru kardinali (3), ara 'tlieta'.
usage_notes.en: Takes the assimilated definite article 'it-Tlieta'; for the cardinal numeral (3), see lowercase 'tlieta'.

entries.source_citation: Kaptan Pawlu Bugeja, Kelmet il-Malti, p. 25 (PDF p. 43); Wiktionary: Erbgħa

definitions.text_mt: Ir-raba' jum tal-ġimgħa wara t-Tlieta u qabel il-Ħamis.

usage_examples.mt: Nhar l-Erbgħa se ssir il-laqgħa ġenerali tal-kunsill.
usage_examples.en: On Wednesday the council's general meeting will be held.
usage_examples.text_mt: Nhar l-Erbgħa se ssir il-laqgħa ġenerali tal-kunsill.
usage_examples.text_en: On Wednesday the council's general meeting will be held.

usage_notes.mt: Jintuża bl-artiklu 'l-Erbgħa'; għan-numru kardinali (4), ara 'erbgħa'.
usage_notes.en: Takes the article 'l-Erbgħa'; for the cardinal numeral (4), see lowercase 'erbgħa'.

entries.source_citation: Kaptan Pawlu Bugeja, Kelmet il-Malti, p. 50 (PDF p. 68); Wiktionary: Ħamis

definitions.text_mt: Il-ħames jum tal-ġimgħa wara l-Erbgħa u qabel il-Ġimgħa.

usage_examples.mt: Nhar il-Ħamis filgħaxija se niltaqgħu fil-pjazza.
usage_examples.en: On Thursday evening we will meet in the square.
usage_examples.text_mt: Nhar il-Ħamis filgħaxija se niltaqgħu fil-pjazza.
usage_examples.text_en: On Thursday evening we will meet in the square.

usage_notes.mt: Jintuża bl-artiklu definit 'il-Ħamis', kif ukoll f'espressjonijiet bħal 'Ħamis ix-Xirka' (Maundy Thursday).
usage_notes.en: Used with the definite article 'il-Ħamis', as well as in fixed expressions like 'Ħamis ix-Xirka' (Maundy Thursday).

definitions.text_mt: Is-sitt jum tal-perjodu ta' sebat ijiem wara l-Ħamis u qabel is-Sibt.

usage_examples.text_mt: Nhar il-Ġimgħa mmorru s-suq ta' filgħodu flimkien.
usage_examples.text_en: On Friday we go to the morning market together.
usage_examples.mt: Nhar il-Ġimgħa mmorru s-suq ta' filgħodu flimkien.
usage_examples.en: On Friday we go to the morning market together.

usage_notes.en: Capitalized as 'il-Ġimgħa' when referring to Friday. For the seven-day period, see lowercase 'ġimgħa'.
usage_notes.mt: Bħala isem proprju tal-jum tinkiteb b'ittra kapitali ('il-Ġimgħa'). Għall-perjodu ta' sebat ijiem, ara l-entrata separata 'ġimgħa'.

entries.source_citation: Kaptan Pawlu Bugeja, Kelmet il-Malti, p. 130 (PDF p. 148); Wiktionary: Sibt

definitions.text_mt: Is-seba' u l-aħħar jum tal-ġimgħa wara l-Ġimgħa u qabel il-Ħadd.

definitions.text_en: Sabbath (day of religious rest in Judaism)
definitions.text_mt: Il-jum sagru ta' mistrieħ u qima fit-tradizzjoni Lhudija u Biblika.

usage_examples.mt: Nhar is-Sibt il-ħwienet tar-raħal jibqgħu miftuħin sa nofsinhar.
usage_examples.en: On Saturday the village shops stay open until noon.
usage_examples.text_mt: Nhar is-Sibt il-ħwienet tar-raħal jibqgħu miftuħin sa nofsinhar.
usage_examples.text_en: On Saturday the village shops stay open until noon.

usage_notes.mt: Jintuża bl-artiklu assimilat 'is-Sibt'. Il-konsonanti finali -bt tidħol b'tħaffif fonetiku bħala [pt].
usage_notes.en: Takes the assimilated definite article 'is-Sibt'. Final -bt undergoes regressive devoicing to [pt].

entries.source_citation: Kaptan Pawlu Bugeja, Kelmet il-Malti, p. 49 (PDF p. 67); Wiktionary: Ħadd

definitions.text_mt: L-ewwel jum tal-ġimgħa tradizzjonali u l-jum ta' mistrieħ wara s-Sibt u qabel it-Tnejn.

usage_examples.mt: Nhar il-Ħadd il-familja kollha tinġabar għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar.
usage_examples.en: On Sunday the whole family gathers for midday lunch.
usage_examples.text_mt: Nhar il-Ħadd il-familja kollha tinġabar għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar.
usage_examples.text_en: On Sunday the whole family gathers for midday lunch.

usage_notes.mt: Jintuża dejjem bl-artiklu definit bħala 'il-Ħadd' (eż. nhar il-Ħadd). Fit-tifsira ta' persuna jew xejn, ara 'ħadd' b'ittra żgħira.
usage_notes.en: Used with the definite article as 'il-Ħadd' (e.g. nhar il-Ħadd). Distinct from lowercase 'ħadd' (anyone, no one).

entries.source_citation: Kaptan Pawlu Bugeja, Kelmet il-Malti, p. 35 (PDF p. 53); National Literacy Agency. (2022). A Bilingual Glossary of Mathematics Terms: The Early and Junior Years, “week” entry; Wiktionary: ġimgħa.

definitions.text_mt: Perjodu ta' sebat ijiem konsekuttivi, mit-Tnejn sal-Ħadd jew minn kwalunkwe jum sal-istess jum ta' wara.

usage_examples.mt: Din il-ġimgħa għandna ħafna xogħol sas-Sibt.
usage_examples.en: This week we have a lot of work until Saturday.
usage_examples.text_mt: Din il-ġimgħa għandna ħafna xogħol sas-Sibt.
usage_examples.text_en: This week we have a lot of work until Saturday.

usage_notes.mt: Għandha forma duali 'ġimagħtejn' (żewġ ġimgħat). Bħala isem ta' jum tinkiteb b'ittra kapitali ('il-Ġimgħa').
usage_notes.en: Has the dual form 'ġimagħtejn' (two weeks). Capitalized as 'il-Ġimgħa' when referring to Friday.

entries.source_citation: Kaptan Pawlu Bugeja, Kelmet il-Malti, p. 28 (PDF p. 46); Wiktionary: festa

definitions.text_mt: Ċelebrazzjoni reliġjuża u popolari fil-parroċċa b'marċi, tiżjin u murtali.
Jum ta' ferħ u għeluq komuni fejn in-nies jiċċelebraw okkażjoni pubblika jew familjari.

usage_examples.mt: Ir-raħal kollu ċċelebra l-festa tal-patrun b'ferħ u nar.
usage_examples.en: The whole village celebrated the patron saint's feast with joy and fireworks.
usage_examples.text_mt: Ir-raħal kollu ċċelebra l-festa tal-patrun b'ferħ u nar.
usage_examples.text_en: The whole village celebrated the patron saint's feast with joy and fireworks.

entries.source_citation: Kaptan Pawlu Bugeja, Kelmet il-Malti, p. 45 (PDF p. 63); Wiktionary: għid

definitions.text_mt: Festa solenni jew ċelebrazzjoni pubblika ta' ferħ u tifkira komuni.
Jum ta' btala reliġjuża jew ċivili ddedikat għaċ-ċelebrazzjoni.
Il-festa ewlenija Nisranija li tfakkar il-Qawmien ta' Kristu (meta tintuża bl-artiklu definit b'ittra kapitali).

usage_examples.mt: Fl-antik kull raħal kellu l-festi u l-għidien tiegħu, u llum il-kelma baqgħet ħajja fl-Għid il-Kbir.
usage_examples.en: In olden times every village had its feasts and festivals, and today the word survives in Easter (l-Għid il-Kbir).
usage_examples.text_mt: Fl-antik kull raħal kellu l-festi u l-għidien tiegħu, u llum il-kelma baqgħet ħajja fl-Għid il-Kbir.
usage_examples.text_en: In olden times every village had its feasts and festivals, and today the word survives in Easter (l-Għid il-Kbir).

usage_notes.mt: Bħala nom komuni għal 'festa' jew 'btala', illum hu arkajku u ġie sostitwit minn 'festa' u 'btala'; jibqa' ħaj bħala isem ta' festi Nsara bħal 'l-Għid il-Kbir' (Easter), 'Għid il-Ħamsin' (Pentecost) u 'Għid il-Ħamiem' (Epiphany).
usage_notes.en: As a common noun for 'feast, holiday', it is now archaic and largely replaced by 'festa' and 'btala'; it survives in fixed Christian feast names such as 'l-Għid il-Kbir' (Easter), 'Għid il-Ħamsin' (Pentecost), and 'Għid il-Ħamiem' (Epiphany).

definitions.text_mt: Medda ta' żmien ta' erba' u għoxrin siegħa, minn nofsillejl sa nofsillejl ta' wara.
Il-perjodu tal-ġurnata meta wieħed ikun imqajjem jew meta tiddi x-xemx.

usage_examples.mt: Awgurajtilha jum sabiħ f'għeluq sninha.
usage_examples.en: I wished her a wonderful day on her birthday.
usage_examples.text_mt: Awgurajtilha jum sabiħ f'għeluq sninha.
usage_examples.text_en: I wished her a wonderful day on her birthday.

usage_notes.mt: Għandu l-forma duali 'jumejn' u l-plural 'jiem' (eż. 'f'dawn il-jiem'), li jieħu l-forma prostetika 'ijiem' wara n-numri 2–10 (bħal 'tlett ijiem'), filwaqt li minn 11 'il fuq jintuża s-singular 'ħdax-il jum'. Ara wkoll 'ġurnata'.
usage_notes.en: Forms the dual 'jumejn' (two days) and the plural 'jiem', which becomes 'ijiem' with an epenthetic vowel after numerals 2–10 (e.g. 'tlett ijiem', whereas 11+ takes singular 'ħdax-il jum'). Compare 'ġurnata'.

definitions.text_mt: Il-medda sħiħa ta' jum meqjusa skont il-ħajja, ix-xogħol jew it-temp li jkun fiha.
Is-sigħat tad-dawl minn sbieħ il-jum sa nżul ix-xemx.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġurnata kienet twila imma mimlija ħidma sabiħa.
usage_examples.en: The day was long yet full of rewarding work.
usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġurnata kienet twila imma mimlija ħidma sabiħa.
usage_examples.text_en: The day was long yet full of rewarding work.

usage_notes.mt: Nom ta' oriġini Rumanza b'plural imkisser Semitiku 'ġranet' (użat spiss man-numri 2–10, eż. 'tliet ġranet'). B'suffissi pussessivi żżomm il-konsonanti doblata ('ġurnatti', 'ġurnatitha').
usage_notes.en: Romance loanword with the Semiticized broken plural 'ġranet' (commonly used after numerals 2–10, e.g. 'tliet ġranet'). Retains doubled -tt- on vowel possessive attachment ('ġurnatti', 'ġurnatitha').

definitions.text_mt: Il-parti tad-dawl tal-ġurnata minn tlugħ ix-xemx sa nżulha.

definitions.text_en: day (in construct before a named day or feast)
definitions.text_mt: Jum speċifiku meta jintuża f'kostruzzjoni qabel isem ta' jum tal-ġimgħa, festa jew data.

usage_examples.mt: Nhar il-Ħadd inġabru l-familji kollha għall-ikla.
usage_examples.en: On Sunday all the families gathered for lunch.
usage_examples.text_mt: Nhar il-Ħadd inġabru l-familji kollha għall-ikla.
usage_examples.text_en: On Sunday all the families gathered for lunch.

usage_notes.mt: Jintuża bħala stat kostrutt avverbjali qabel il-jiem u l-festi (eż. 'nhar it-Tnejn', 'nhar il-Milied'). Il-prepożizzjoni marbuta miegħu hi 'binhar'.
usage_notes.en: Used in construct position before named days, feasts, and dates ('nhar it-Tnejn', 'nhar il-Milied'). Forms the adverbial 'binhar'.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-ġurnata preżenti li qegħdin fiha bħalissa.
Fiż-żminijiet attwali u moderni tal-preżent.

usage_examples.mt: Illum huwa jum importanti għall-istudenti li rċevew ir-riżultati.
usage_examples.en: Today is an important day for the students who received their results.
usage_examples.text_mt: Illum huwa jum importanti għall-istudenti li rċevew ir-riżultati.
usage_examples.text_en: Today is an important day for the students who received their results.

usage_notes.mt: Il-forma sħiħa 'illum' tintuża fil-bidu ta' sentenza jew wara konsonanti; wara vokali spiss taqa' l-ewwel vokali u tinkiteb 'llum' (eż. 'sa llum', 'ta' llum').
usage_notes.en: The full form 'illum' is used clause-initially or after consonants; after a vowel, aphaeresis commonly produces 'llum' (e.g. 'sa llum', 'ta' llum').

definitions.text_en: today (post-vocalic or aphaeretic variant of illum)
definitions.text_mt: Fil-ġurnata preżenti li qegħdin fiha, b'forma mnaqqsa wara vokali jew fil-bidu tad-diskors.

usage_examples.mt: Sa llum għadna nistennew it-tweġiba uffiċjali.
usage_examples.en: Up to today we are still waiting for the official reply.
usage_examples.text_mt: Sa llum għadna nistennew it-tweġiba uffiċjali.
usage_examples.text_en: Up to today we are still waiting for the official reply.

usage_notes.mt: Varjant fonoloġiku standard wara vokali (eż. 'minn hawn sa llum', 'il-ħajja tal-lum'). Ara l-entrata sħiħa 'illum'.
usage_notes.en: Standard phonological variant after vowels (e.g. 'minn hawn sa llum'). See the full form 'illum'.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-jum immedjatament ta' qabel il-ġurnata tal-preżent.

usage_examples.mt: Ilbieraħ mort inżur lin-nanna l-isptar.
usage_examples.en: Yesterday I went to visit my grandmother at the hospital.
usage_examples.text_mt: Ilbieraħ mort inżur lin-nanna l-isptar.
usage_examples.text_en: Yesterday I went to visit my grandmother at the hospital.

usage_notes.mt: Wara vokali taqa' l-vokali tal-bidu u tintuża l-forma 'lbieraħ' (eż. 'sa lbieraħ'). Għal jumejn ilu, ara 'ilbieraħtlula'.
usage_notes.en: After vowels, aphaeresis yields 'lbieraħ' (e.g. 'sa lbieraħ'). For 'the day before yesterday', see 'ilbieraħtlula'.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-jum ta' qabel illum, miktub mingħajr l-ewwel vokali wara kelma li tispiċċa b'vokali.

usage_examples.mt: Sa lbieraħ filgħaxija kien għadu ma wasalx.
usage_examples.en: Until yesterday evening he had still not arrived.
usage_examples.text_mt: Sa lbieraħ filgħaxija kien għadu ma wasalx.
usage_examples.text_en: Until yesterday evening he had still not arrived.

usage_notes.mt: Forma post-vokalika ta' 'ilbieraħ'.
usage_notes.en: Post-vocalic phonological variant of 'ilbieraħ'.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-jum immedjatament ta' wara l-ġurnata tal-preżent.
Iż-żmien li ġej, il-futur li għad irid jasal.

usage_examples.mt: Għada filgħodu għandna laqgħa kmieni l-uffiċċju.
usage_examples.en: Tomorrow morning we have an early meeting at the office.
usage_examples.text_mt: Għada filgħodu għandna laqgħa kmieni l-uffiċċju.
usage_examples.text_en: Tomorrow morning we have an early meeting at the office.

usage_notes.en: From root għ-d-w (shared with 'għodu' and 'għodwa'). For two days ahead, see 'pitgħada'.
usage_notes.mt: Mill-istess għerq ta' 'għodu' u 'għodwa' (għ-d-w). Għal jumejn 'il quddiem, ara 'pitgħada'.

definitions.text_mt: Drawwa jew imġiba mtennija spiss li ssir parti mill-ħajja ta' persuna jew poplu

usage_examples.mt: Kienet għada qadima fir-raħal li kulħadd jiltaqa’ fil-pjazza wara l-quddies.
usage_examples.en: It was an old custom in the village for everyone to gather in the square after Mass.
usage_examples.text_mt: Kienet għada qadima fir-raħal li kulħadd jiltaqa’ fil-pjazza wara l-quddies.
usage_examples.text_en: It was an old custom in the village for everyone to gather in the square after Mass.

usage_notes.en: Archaic noun from root għ-w-d, largely replaced today by 'drawwa'.
usage_notes.mt: Kelma arkajka mill-għerq għ-w-d li llum tintuża minflokha 'drawwa'.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-jum immedjatament ta' wara għada, jumejn oħra minn illum.

usage_examples.mt: Pitgħada nitilqu kmieni biex naslu qabel nofsinhar.
usage_examples.en: The day after tomorrow we leave early to arrive before noon.
usage_examples.text_mt: Pitgħada nitilqu kmieni biex naslu qabel nofsinhar.
usage_examples.text_en: The day after tomorrow we leave early to arrive before noon.

usage_notes.en: Historically derived from Arabic 'bagħda ghada' ('after tomorrow'), with a dialectal voiced variant 'bitgħada'.
usage_notes.mt: Komposta storikament minn 'bagħd (wara) għada'; bil-varjant djalettali jew mitkellem 'bitgħada'.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-jum ta' wara għada, b'konsonanti tal-bidu leħenija minflok il-forma standard 'pitgħada'.

usage_examples.mt: Narak bitgħada kmieni filgħodu fir-raħal.
usage_examples.en: I will see you the day after tomorrow early in the morning in the village.
usage_examples.text_mt: Narak bitgħada kmieni filgħodu fir-raħal.
usage_examples.text_en: I will see you the day after tomorrow early in the morning in the village.

usage_notes.en: Spoken and dialectal variant of standard 'pitgħada'.
usage_notes.mt: Varjant mitkellem u djalettali ta' 'pitgħada'.

etymology_chain.definition: the former last night, i.e. the day before yesterday

definitions.text_mt: Fil-jum immedjatament ta' qabel ilbieraħ, jumejn ilu minn illum.

usage_examples.mt: Ilbieraħtlula bdejna nlestu d-dokumenti kollha għal-laqgħa.
usage_examples.en: The day before yesterday we started preparing all the documents for the meeting.
usage_examples.text_mt: Ilbieraħtlula bdejna nlestu d-dokumenti kollha għal-laqgħa.
usage_examples.text_en: The day before yesterday we started preparing all the documents for the meeting.

usage_notes.en: Compound of 'ilbieraħ' (yesterday) and archaic 'l-ūlā' (the first). Post-vocalic 'lbieraħtlula' and reduced forms 'bieraħtlula', 'ilbiraħtlula', and 'lbiraħtlula' occur, alongside the folk rhotic orthographies 'ilbiraħtlura' and 'lbiraħtlura' (influenced by 'lura').
usage_notes.mt: Kompost minn 'ilbieraħ' u l-element arkajku 'l-ula' (l-ewwel). Wara vokali jinkiteb 'lbieraħtlula', u jeżistu l-forom mitkellma 'bieraħtlula', 'ilbiraħtlula' u 'lbiraħtlula', flimkien mal-kitbiet popolari bir-r 'ilbiraħtlura' u 'lbiraħtlura' (influwenzati minn 'lura').

alternative_forms.notes: Folk orthography (rhotic assimilation influenced by lura)

usage_examples.mt: Sa lbieraħtlula konna għadna ma smajna xejn mingħandhom.

definitions.text_en: the day before yesterday (shortened spelling variant)
definitions.text_mt: Fil-jum ta' qabel ilbieraħ, b'kitba mqassra li tirrifletti l-pronunzja ta' 'ilbieraħtlula'.

usage_examples.mt: Ilbiraħtlula ġew iżuruna xi qraba minn Għawdex.
usage_examples.en: The day before yesterday some relatives from Gozo came to visit us.
usage_examples.text_mt: Ilbiraħtlula ġew iżuruna xi qraba minn Għawdex.
usage_examples.text_en: The day before yesterday some relatives from Gozo came to visit us.

usage_notes.mt: Kitba mqassra ta' 'ilbieraħtlula' bla d-dittong 'ie'. Il-forom 'ilbiraħtlura' u 'lbiraħtlura' huma kitbiet popolari bir-r minħabba l-assoċjazzjoni ma' 'lura'.
usage_notes.en: Phonetic spelling variant of 'ilbieraħtlula' reflecting unstressed reduction of 'ie' to 'i'. The forms 'ilbiraħtlura' and 'lbiraħtlura' are folk orthographies with rhotic assimilation to 'lura'.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-jum ta' qabel ilbieraħ, b'varjant mitkellem u post-vokaliku ta' 'ilbieraħtlula'.

usage_examples.mt: Lbiraħtlula rajthom mexjin ħdejn ix-xatt.
usage_examples.en: The day before yesterday I saw them walking along the seafront.
usage_examples.text_mt: Lbiraħtlula rajthom mexjin ħdejn ix-xatt.
usage_examples.text_en: The day before yesterday I saw them walking along the seafront.

usage_notes.mt: Varjant kollokwjali ta' 'ilbieraħtlula'.
usage_notes.en: Colloquial variant of 'ilbieraħtlula'.

etymology_chain.definition: the former last night, i.e. the day before yesterday

definitions.text_en: the day before yesterday (rhotic dialectal variant)
definitions.text_mt: Fil-jum ta' qabel ilbieraħ, b'bidla tal-'l' f''r' fit-tarf tal-kelma minħabba l-assoċjazzjoni ma' 'lura'.

usage_examples.mt: Lbiraħtlura kien hawn riħ qawwi mill-Majjistral.
usage_examples.en: The day before yesterday there was a strong northwesterly wind here.
usage_examples.text_mt: Lbiraħtlura kien hawn riħ qawwi mill-Majjistral.
usage_examples.text_en: The day before yesterday there was a strong northwesterly wind here.

usage_notes.mt: Varjant djalettali ta' 'ilbieraħtlula' b'assimilanzi lejn 'lura' ('back').
usage_notes.en: Dialectal folk-etymological variant of 'ilbieraħtlula' influenced by 'lura' ('back').

definitions.text_mt: F'kull jum bla eċċezzjoni, b'mod regolari ġurnata wara l-oħra.
Li hu tas-soltu u parti mir-rutina ordinarja ta' kull ġurnata.

usage_examples.mt: Jaqra l-gazzetta kuljum filgħodu qabel ix-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: He reads the newspaper every day in the morning before work.
usage_examples.text_mt: Jaqra l-gazzetta kuljum filgħodu qabel ix-xogħol.
usage_examples.text_en: He reads the newspaper every day in the morning before work.

usage_notes.mt: Kompost minn 'kull' u 'jum'. Jintuża kemm bħala avverbju ('jiġri kuljum') kif ukoll f'kostruzzjonijiet bħal 'ta' kuljum' ('ħwejjeġ ta' kuljum').
usage_notes.en: Compound of 'kull' (every) and 'jum' (day). Used both adverbially and adjectivally in 'ta' kuljum' ('everyday, daily').

definitions.text_mt: L-ewwel parti tal-jum, minn sbieħ il-ġurnata u tlugħ ix-xemx sa qabel nofsinhar.

usage_examples.mt: Għodwa sabiħa b’riħ ħafif tħajrek toħroġ timxi ħdejn il-baħar.
usage_examples.en: A lovely morning with a light breeze invites you to walk by the sea.
usage_examples.text_mt: Għodwa sabiħa b’riħ ħafif tħajrek toħroġ timxi ħdejn il-baħar.
usage_examples.text_en: A lovely morning with a light breeze invites you to walk by the sea.

usage_notes.mt: Jintuża bħala nom magħdud għal għodwa speċifika ('għodwa waħda', 'tliet għodwiet') u fit-tislima 'l-għodwa t-tajba'. Ara wkoll 'għodu' u 'filgħodu'.
usage_notes.en: Countable noun for a specific morning ('għodwa waħda', pl. 'għodwiet'), also in the greeting 'l-għodwa t-tajba'. Related to 'għodu' and 'filgħodu'.

definitions.text_mt: Is-sigħat bikrija tal-bidu tal-ġurnata wara tlugħ ix-xemx.

usage_examples.mt: Mal-ewwel dawl ta' għodu s-sajjieda kienu diġà fuq il-lanċa.
usage_examples.en: At the first light of morning the fishermen were already on the boat.
usage_examples.text_mt: Mal-ewwel dawl ta' għodu s-sajjieda kienu diġà fuq il-lanċa.
usage_examples.text_en: At the first light of morning the fishermen were already on the boat.

usage_notes.mt: Jinstema' l-aktar fil-kompost 'filgħodu', f''dalgħodu', u fl-espressjoni rduppjata 'għodu għodu' (kmieni ħafna). Ara wkoll 'għodwa'.
usage_notes.en: Occurs mainly in compounds ('filgħodu', 'dalgħodu') and the reduplicated adverb 'għodu għodu' ('early morning'). Compare 'għodwa'.

definitions.text_mt: Fl-ewwel sigħat tal-ġurnata, bejn sbieħ il-jum u nofsinhar.

usage_examples.mt: Ixrob kafè sħun filgħodu qabel ma titlaq għax-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: Drink a hot coffee in the morning before leaving for work.
usage_examples.text_mt: Ixrob kafè sħun filgħodu qabel ma titlaq għax-xogħol.
usage_examples.text_en: Drink a hot coffee in the morning before leaving for work.

usage_notes.mt: Kitba standard magħquda minn 'fi + il- + għodu'. Il-kitba mifruda 'fil-għodu' tidher f'testi antiki imma mhijiex preferuta llum.
usage_notes.en: Standard fused spelling of 'fi + il- + għodu'. Hyphenated 'fil-għodu' appears in older texts.

definitions.text_mt: Fl-ewwel sigħat tal-ġurnata, f'kitba eqdem bis-sing ta' 'filgħodu'.

usage_examples.mt: Qam kmieni fil-għodu biex jibda jaħdem fir-raba'.
usage_examples.en: He got up early in the morning to start working in the field.
usage_examples.text_mt: Qam kmieni fil-għodu biex jibda jaħdem fir-raba'.
usage_examples.text_en: He got up early in the morning to start working in the field.

usage_notes.mt: Ortografija eqdem ta' 'filgħodu'; illum tinkiteb kelma waħda.
usage_notes.en: Older hyphenated spelling of 'filgħodu'.

definitions.text_mt: Nofs il-ġurnata eżatt meta x-xemx tilħaq l-ogħla punt fis-sema, fis-siegħa tnax ta' binhar.
Id-direzzjoni kardinali opposta għat-Tramuntana, lejn in-naħa fejn tidher ix-xemx f'nofs il-jum.

usage_examples.mt: Kielu l-ikla ewlenija f'nofsinhar mat-tfal.
usage_examples.en: They ate their main meal at noon with the children.
usage_examples.text_mt: Kielu l-ikla ewlenija f'nofsinhar mat-tfal.
usage_examples.text_en: They ate their main meal at noon with the children.

usage_notes.mt: Kompost minn 'nofs + in-nhar'. Bħala punt kardinali, il-bidla semantika minn 'nofs il-jum' għal 'nofsinhar (south)' tirrifletti l-qagħda tax-xemx f'nofs il-ġurnata fl-emisferu tat-Tramuntana (bħal 'mezzogiorno' fit-Taljan). Jintuża wkoll avverbjalment ('f'nofsinhar', 'qabel nofsinhar').
usage_notes.en: Compound of 'nofs' (half, middle) + 'in-nhar' (the day). The sense 'south' reflects the sun's midday position (comparable to Italian 'mezzogiorno'). Also functions adverbially ('f'nofsinhar').

definitions.text_mt: Il-parti tal-ġurnata minn wara nofsinhar sa nżul ix-xemx u filgħaxija.

usage_examples.mt: Waranofsinhar immorru nimxu fil-kampanja qabel ma jidlam.
usage_examples.en: In the afternoon we will go walking in the countryside before it gets dark.
usage_examples.text_mt: Waranofsinhar immorru nimxu fil-kampanja qabel ma jidlam.
usage_examples.text_en: In the afternoon we will go walking in the countryside before it gets dark.

usage_notes.mt: Kompost minn 'wara' u 'nofsinhar', u spiss jintuża bħala avverbju bla prepożizzjoni ('wasal waranofsinhar'). Jinkiteb ukoll b'żewġ kelmiet bħala 'wara nofsinhar'.
usage_notes.en: Compound of 'wara' (after) + 'nofsinhar' (noon); frequently used adverbially without a preposition. Also written open as 'wara nofsinhar'.

definitions.text_mt: Il-medda tal-ġurnata wara nofsinhar sa filgħaxija, miktuba mifruda f'żewġ kelmiet.

usage_examples.mt: Iltaqgħu wara nofsinhar fil-kafetterija tar-raħal.
usage_examples.en: They met in the afternoon at the village cafe.
usage_examples.text_mt: Iltaqgħu wara nofsinhar fil-kafetterija tar-raħal.
usage_examples.text_en: They met in the afternoon at the village cafe.

usage_notes.mt: Kitba mifruda ta' 'waranofsinhar'.
usage_notes.en: Open-spaced spelling of 'waranofsinhar'.

definitions.text_mt: Il-parti tal-ġurnata wara nżul ix-xemx u qabel il-lejl.

usage_examples.mt: Kienet għaxija sabiħa u kalma ħdejn il-port.
usage_examples.en: It was a lovely and calm evening by the harbour.
usage_examples.text_mt: Kienet għaxija sabiħa u kalma ħdejn il-port.
usage_examples.text_en: It was a lovely and calm evening by the harbour.

usage_notes.mt: Nom bażi li minnu jissawwar l-avverbju kompost 'filgħaxija' (f' + il- + għaxija). Ara wkoll 'lejla'.
usage_notes.en: Base noun from which 'filgħaxija' ('in the evening') is formed. Compare 'lejla'.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-ħin ta' wara nżul ix-xemx u qabel il-lejl.

usage_examples.mt: Ħarġu jimxu filgħaxija mal-kosta tal-baħar.
usage_examples.en: They went out for a walk in the evening along the sea coast.
usage_examples.text_mt: Ħarġu jimxu filgħaxija mal-kosta tal-baħar.
usage_examples.text_en: They went out for a walk in the evening along the sea coast.

usage_notes.mt: Kitba standard magħquda minn 'fi + il- + għaxija'. L-għamliet 'fil-għaxija' u 'flgħaxija' huma varjanti eqdem jew mhux preferuti.
usage_notes.en: Standard fused spelling of 'fi + il- + għaxija'. Older or non-standard spellings include 'fil-għaxija' and 'flgħaxija'.

definitions.text_mt: Il-perjodu tal-jum minn wara nżul ix-xemx sas-siegħat bikrija tal-lejl; għaxija.

usage_examples.mt: Dik il-filgħaxija kienet waħda kwieta u sabiħa fir-raħal.
usage_examples.en: That evening was a quiet and lovely one in the village.
usage_examples.text_mt: Dik il-filgħaxija kienet waħda kwieta u sabiħa fir-raħal.
usage_examples.text_en: That evening was a quiet and lovely one in the village.

usage_notes.mt: Għalkemm oriġinarjament avverbju ('f' + il- + għaxija'), jintuża wkoll bħala nom femminili bil-plural 'filgħaxijiet'.
usage_notes.en: Originally an adverbial prepositional phrase, also fully lexicalized as a feminine noun with plural 'filgħaxijiet'.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-ħin ta' wara nżul ix-xemx, f'kitba eqdem bis-sing ta' 'filgħaxija'.

usage_examples.mt: Niltaqgħu fil-għaxija quddiem il-knisja biex nimxu.
usage_examples.en: We will meet in the evening in front of the church for a walk.

usage_notes.mt: Ortografija eqdem bis-sing ta' 'filgħaxija'.

definitions.text_mt: Il-perjodu tal-jum meta tinżel ix-xemx, f'kitba eqdem bis-sing ta' 'filgħaxija'.

usage_examples.mt: Dik il-fil-għaxija kienet waħda mill-aktar kwieti fir-raħal.

definitions.text_mt: Fil-ħin ta' wara nżul ix-xemx, b'kitba mqassra li tirrifletti t-telf tal-ewwel 'i' fit-taħdit.

usage_examples.mt: Niltaqgħu flgħaxija fil-pjazza tar-raħal.

definitions.text_mt: Il-perjodu ta' wara nżul ix-xemx, b'kitba mqassra ta' 'filgħaxija'.

usage_examples.mt: Kienet flgħaxija mill-isbaħ f’nofs is-sajf.
usage_examples.en: It was a wonderful evening in the middle of summer.

definitions.text_mt: Il-perjodu ta' dlam bejn l-inżul u t-tlugħ tax-xemx.

usage_examples.mt: Il-lejl kien kwiet u mimli kwiekeb fis-sema.
usage_examples.en: The night was quiet and full of stars in the sky.
usage_examples.text_mt: Il-lejl kien kwiet u mimli kwiekeb fis-sema.

usage_notes.mt: Għandu żewġ forom ta' plural: 'ljieli' (użat speċjalment man-numri 2–10 bħala 'tlett iljieli') u 'lejlijiet'. Ara wkoll 'lejla' (lejl wieħed determinat) u 'billejl'.
usage_notes.en: Has two plurals: broken 'ljieli' (used after numerals 2–10 as 'tlett iljieli') and 'lejlijiet'. Compare singulative and bounded 'lejla' and adverbial 'billejl'.

definitions.text_mt: Lejl wieħed determinat jew il-medda tal-bidu tiegħu; serata.
Attività soċjali, kulturali jew mużikali li ssir matul serata waħda.

usage_examples.mt: Għamlu lejla mużikali fil-pjazza tar-raħal fis-sajf.
usage_examples.en: They held a musical evening in the village square in summer.
usage_examples.text_mt: Għamlu lejla mużikali fil-pjazza tar-raħal fis-sajf.
usage_examples.text_en: They held a musical evening in the village square in summer.

usage_notes.mt: Nom femminili singulattiv minn 'lejl', b'forma duali 'lejltejn' u plural 'lejliet'. Fl-istat kostrutt quddiem isem ieħor jieħu 't marbuta': 'lejlet' (eż. 'Lejlet il-Milied').
usage_notes.en: Feminine singulative noun corresponding to 'lejl', with dual 'lejltejn' and plural 'lejliet'. In construct state before another noun, uses t marbuta: 'lejlet' (e.g. 'Lejlet il-Milied').

definitions.text_mt: Nofs il-lejl eżatt, meta tintemm ġurnata u tibda oħra fis-siegħa tnax ta' billejl.

usage_examples.mt: Wasal lura d-dar preċiżament f’nofsillejl.
usage_examples.en: He arrived back home precisely at midnight.
usage_examples.text_mt: Wasal lura d-dar preċiżament f’nofsillejl.

usage_notes.mt: Kompost minn 'nofs + il- + lejl'. Jinkiteb ukoll b'żewġ kelmiet bħala 'nofs il-lejl'.
usage_notes.en: Compound of 'nofs' (middle) + 'il-lejl' (the night). Also written open as 'nofs il-lejl'.

definitions.text_mt: Il-punt ċentrali tal-lejl fis-siegħa tnax ta' billejl, miktub f'forma mifruda ta' 'nofsillejl'.

usage_examples.mt: Il-qniepen daqqew f’nofs il-lejl lejlet l-ewwel tas-sena.
usage_examples.en: The bells rang at midnight on New Year’s Eve.

usage_notes.en: Open-spaced spelling of 'nofsillejl'.

tag_guidelines.time: Use for meanings that directly denote time, a temporal unit, duration, a date or time expression, or a part of the day. It is not an automatic tag for every entry in this category.
tag_guidelines.days of the week: Use for the seven capitalized weekday names, together with time.
tag_guidelines.months: Use for the twelve capitalized Gregorian month names and the common noun xahar, together with time.
tag_guidelines.seasons: Use for the four season names and the common noun staġun, together with time.
tag_guidelines.holidays: Use for feast and holiday senses such as festa and għid.
tag_guidelines.religion: Add when a tagged feast has a specifically religious sense; it can accompany holidays.
tag_guidelines.customs: Use for the archaic homograph għada meaning a repeated practice or custom; do not tag that sense as time.

notable_tag_policy.editor_behavior: The Notable (!) checkbox prefixes the next tag with !. It does not persist as a separate is_notable field on an entry.
notable_tag_policy.default: Use !rgħajn on all entries etymologically derived from Arabic ghayn (غ), and !time on foundational time nouns and notable temporal compounds. Keep days of the week, months, seasons, holidays, religion, customs, and routine orthographic variants unprefixed.
